# `/saved-searches` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /saved-searches/v1

`createSavedSearchV1` — Create a saved search

Creates a new saved search.

- Scopes: sp:saved-search:manage
- Body (application/json): object
- Returns 201: savedsearch

### GET /saved-searches/v1

`listSavedSearchesV1` — A list of saved searches

Returns a list of saved searches.

- Scopes: sp:saved-search:read
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: owner.id: eq — e.g. `owner.id eq "7a724640-0c17-4ce9-a8c3-4a89738459c8"`
- Returns 200: array of savedsearch

### PUT /saved-searches/v1/{id}

`putSavedSearchV1` — Updates an existing saved search


Updates an existing saved search. >**NOTE: You cannot update the `owner` of the saved search.**

- Scopes: sp:saved-search:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the requested document.
- Body (application/json): savedsearch
- Returns 200: savedsearch

### GET /saved-searches/v1/{id}

`getSavedSearchV1` — Return saved search by id

Returns the specified saved search.

- Scopes: sp:saved-search:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the requested document.
- Returns 200: savedsearch

### DELETE /saved-searches/v1/{id}

`deleteSavedSearchV1` — Delete document by id

Deletes the specified saved search.

- Scopes: sp:saved-search:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the requested document.
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /saved-searches/v1/{id}/execute

`executeSavedSearchV1` — Execute a saved search by id

Executes the specified saved search.

- Scopes: sp:saved-search:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the requested document.
- Body (application/json): searcharguments
- Returns 202: no body
